chapter.title: On the Run
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 at flowchart-node level from the PowerPyx 100% chart (132 boxes, seven ending tiles, six ending labels) and the game’s text (the detroitbecometext template resolved against the string table). Three starts from Fugitives: MORNING IN PARKING LOT (explore the lot, hair, trunk clothes) and MORNING IN MOTEL (Alice talk, bath and hair, the TV report about Todd, cheer Alice up, Connor at the desk and the side door) merge into KARA & ALICE IN THE STREET (sneak or be spotted: REACHED THE TRAIN SAFELY); MORNING IN SQUAT (explore, upstairs hair, clothes and the gun, Ralph’s meal and the table, Connor’s interrogation and search: KARA & ALICE UNDISCOVERED IN SQUAT). Every chase runs CONNOR PURSUES KARA > the fence (KARA & ALICE VANISHED, KARA & ALICE CROSSED THE HIGHWAY, or the highway) > HANK ORDERS CONNOR NOT TO GO (GIVE UP / GO) > the quick-time crossings (KARA & ALICE REACHED THE OTHER SIDE ×2, KARA & ALICE DIED ON THE HIGHWAY). Arrows: the template’s Alice and public-opinion arrows; Hank and instability arrows from the wiki only (flagged). Researched in docs/research/ch13-on-the-run.md.

decisions.note: Shelter read from ch10Shelter, shelter, karaRoute, then ch10Ending; unknown falls back to the car.
decisions.title: Morning in parking lot, motel or squat (checkpoints)
decisions.context: The chapter has three starts, picked by where Kara slept in Fugitives.

options.label: Abandoned car
options.effect: MORNING IN PARKING LOT: Alice asleep, Kara alone; trunk clothes if none were stolen.

options.label: Motel
options.effect: MORNING IN MOTEL: Alice dialogue, the TV report, police at the motel.

options.label: Squat
options.effect: MORNING IN SQUAT: Ralph’s meal and Connor’s search.

decisions.gate: Kara and Alice alive after Fugitives.

benchmark.note: Three start events; each records the inputs (clothes, gun, Todd’s shooter, wire cutters) in ch13 state.

decisions.title: Explore parking lot
decisions.context: Kara changes her appearance while Alice sleeps in the car.

options.label: Rusted scissors
options.effect: CUT AND COLOR HAIR, then REMOVE LED.

options.label: Trunk, crowbar, clothes
options.effect: FIND SOME CLOTHES (only without the laundromat clothes); sets clothes.

options.label: Burnt android, two magazines
options.effect: Observation only.

options.label: Check neighborhood
options.effect: POLICE IS IN VICINITY; unmissable.

options.label: Wake up Alice
options.effect: Leave the lot (needs the haircut and the look outside).

decisions.gate: Kara slept in the abandoned car.

benchmark.note: Repeatable hub; the Connor supermarket checkpoint and POLICE DON’T HAVE A LEAD are an event.

decisions.note: Cross-chapter padlock on the chart; no later gate is known.
decisions.title: Cut and color hair
decisions.context: Kara cuts her hair short and picks a color; the LED comes out.

options.label: BROWN
options.effect: Recorded as ch13Hair.

options.label: BLACK
options.effect: Recorded as ch13Hair.

options.label: WHITE
options.effect: Recorded as ch13Hair.

options.label: BLONDE
options.effect: Recorded as ch13Hair.

decisions.gate: Every row: under the scissors (car), the bath (motel) or upstairs (squat).

benchmark.note: An interrupt decision inside each hub.

decisions.title: Talk to Alice (motel)
decisions.context: Alice wakes in the motel: “So, it wasn’t a nightmare…”

options.label: BATH?
options.effect: Alice up.

options.label: HUNGRY?
options.effect: Alice up.

options.label: TIRED?
options.effect: No change.

benchmark.note: Template arrows: Alice +1 on BATH? and HUNGRY?.

decisions.title: The motel room and the TV report
decisions.context: Draw a bath, cut hair, explore; then Alice hears about Todd on the news.

options.label: Explore the room
options.effect: Clock, window, painting, two magazines; optional. The direct room-to-TV edge also permits skipping the bath and haircut.

options.label: Finish drawing bath
options.effect: Then CHANGE CHANNEL: ALICE HEARS ABOUT TODD, public opinion down (either report).

benchmark.note: Repeatable hub; the TV is an unavoidable event with publicSupport −1 and the template’s three variants (Todd dead, shot by Kara or by Alice; Todd alive).

decisions.title: What next, and cheer Alice up
decisions.context: “What are we gonna do? We have nowhere to go…”

options.label: CAN’T STAY HERE / FAMILY / CONTACT ANDROID
options.effect: No change.

options.label: MOVING / DETERMINED / COMFORTING / SUPPORTIVE
options.effect: Alice up on each.

benchmark.note: Two prompts, then LOOK FOR BREAKFAST and KARA SPOTS POLICE FORCES as an event.

decisions.title: Connor at the motel: the desk and the side door
decisions.context: The receptionist gives up room 28; Hank tells Connor to wait in the car.

options.label: RATIONAL / DIPLOMATIC / DIRECT
options.effect: Hank down on any (wiki only; template silent).

options.label: FOLLOW HANK
options.effect: HANK CHECKS MOTEL ROOM: “It’s gone…”; Kara reaches the street.

options.label: CHECK THE DOOR
options.effect: “Found you.” Straight to the chase.

benchmark.note: The desk Hank −1 is flagged for the operator.

decisions.note: Stealth gameplay, not a menu. The old K09 let walking openly end in a death on the freeway; the chart has no death before the chase.
decisions.title: Sneak past the police or be spotted
decisions.context: Kara and Alice walk toward the train station through a street full of police.

options.label: Sneak past police forces
options.effect: REACHED THE TRAIN SAFELY; no chase (risk roll; failure is SPOTTED BY POLICE).

options.label: Walk in the open
options.effect: Always SPOTTED BY POLICE > KARA & ALICE RUN AWAY > CONNOR PURSUES KARA.

decisions.gate: Car start, or motel start after FOLLOW HANK.

decisions.title: Explore squat, upstairs, and the gun
decisions.context: Kara revives the fire, may steal Ralph’s money, cuts her hair upstairs and may change clothes.

options.label: STEAL / PUT BACK
options.effect: STEAL MONEY sets money.

options.label: FIND CORPSE IN BATHTUB
options.effect: Unlocks [ASK ABOUT CORPSE].

options.label: CHANGE CLOTHES > TAKE GUN BACK
options.effect: Keeps the gun.

options.label: CHANGE CLOTHES > FORGOT GUN
options.effect: The gun stays upstairs; [CHECK GUN] finds it gone.

decisions.gate: Kara slept in the squat; the clothes need no laundromat clothes; the gun needs Stormy Night’s gun.

benchmark.note: Two repeatable hubs (ground floor, upstairs) with interrupts for the money and the hair.

decisions.title: Ralph wants a family meal
decisions.context: Ralph has caught a rodent and wants a family dinner; Connor and Hank are across the street.

options.label: SIT
options.effect: Sit at the table.

options.label: REFUSE, then REFUSE
options.effect: RALPH THREATENS ALICE; Alice up on the second refusal.

options.label: [CHECK GUN] / WORRIED / EXPLAIN / AGREE
options.effect: No change; CHECK GUN reveals a forgotten gun.

options.label: LIE / TRUTH
options.effect: Alice up / Alice down.

benchmark.note: POLICE ARRIVES is the Connor cutscene across the street (with the wire-cutters variant).

decisions.note: Ralph’s betrayal is driven by this threat, not by the Fugitives gun threat.
decisions.title: At the table: discuss the corpse, convince or threaten Ralph

options.label: [ASK ABOUT CORPSE] then [INSIST ABOUT CORPSE]
options.effect: DISCUSS CORPSE > RALPH APOLOGIZES.

options.label: FAMILY
options.effect: TRY TO CONVINCE RALPH > RALPH APOLOGIZES.

options.label: BLUFF
options.effect: “Not until Ralph says so.” The menu comes back.

options.label: THREATEN (knife, or the gun)
options.effect: Ralph informs on Kara when Connor arrives; ralphHostile.

benchmark.note: Up to three asks of the same prompt; DISTURBED BY CONNOR as an event.

decisions.title: Connor investigates the squat
decisions.context: Blue blood on the fence leads Connor into the squat, where Ralph meets him.

options.label: AX400 / DEVIANTS / REASSURE / BLUE BLOOD (/ PRESSURIZE)
options.effect: If Kara threatened Ralph: SQUAT DEVIANT INFORMS ON AX400 and the chase.

options.label: CHECK UNDER THE STAIRS
options.effect: SQUAT ANDROID ATTACKS CONNOR > AX400 AND CHILD ESCAPED; ralphDefended.

options.label: Other checks, or LEAVE THE SQUAT
options.effect: HANK COMMANDS CONNOR TO LEAVE > SQUAT ANDROID DISAPPEARS > KARA & ALICE UNDISCOVERED IN SQUAT.

benchmark.note: Repeatable search hub; Hank calls after three empty looks and orders Connor out after five (unsourced counts).

decisions.note: Sets chase for Jericho’s magazine and Zlatko’s TV.
decisions.title: Run toward their last known position
decisions.context: Connor chases Kara and Alice toward the highway.

options.label: Stay where he is
options.effect: REACH FENCE TOO LATE > KARA & ALICE VANISHED.

options.label: Run partway
options.effect: REACH FENCE TOO LATE > KARA & ALICE CROSSED THE HIGHWAY.

options.label: Run hard
options.effect: REACH FENCE IN TIME (risk roll; failure is too late).

decisions.gate: Any chase: spotted, the motel door, Ralph informed, or found under the stairs.

benchmark.note: The old C09 always assumed Connor reached the fence.

decisions.note: The template has no Connor arrow; the wiki states these on two pages each (flagged).
decisions.title: Pursue Kara onto the highway?
decisions.context: Hank orders Connor not to follow: “Do NOT go after ’em, Connor, that’s an order!”

options.label: GIVE UP
options.effect: Hank up, instability up (wiki); The Nest’s [HIGHWAY] button.

options.label: GO
options.effect: Hank down, instability down (wiki); Connor crosses and can die.

decisions.gate: Kara and Alice reach the middle section.

decisions.title: Crossing the highway
decisions.context: Six quick-time checks on Experienced: Kara’s three crossings, the fight, and Connor’s two.

options.label: All crossings made
options.effect: KARA & ALICE REACHED THE OTHER SIDE (Connor standing, or Connor destroyed).

options.label: Any Kara check failed
options.effect: KARA & ALICE DIED ON THE HIGHWAY; Kara’s storyline ends.

options.label: A Connor check failed
options.effect: CAR HITS CONNOR / CONNOR HIT BY CAR: replaced; instability down; The Nest’s Hank insult.

benchmark.note: Single-action risky scenes; endings recorded in ch13Ending.
